name: allocation_step
label_en: the most a campaign's budget moves in a day
label_zh: 每天最多调整预算的幅度
explain: the owner's rhythm: up or down by a tenth
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_step_fast
label_en: the step after the evidence has pointed the same way for allocation_fast_days
label_zh: 证据持续同向后的加速步幅
explain: the owner's acceleration idea; guarded by allocation_fast_days
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_fast_days
label_en: days the evidence must point the same way before the faster step is allowed
label_zh: 证据同向多少天才允许加速
explain: reset the moment the sign flips
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_cooldown_days
label_en: days after a move before the same campaign moves again
explain: a platform's response to a budget change and the conversion lag mean a move is read late
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_min_days
label_en: days a campaign needs before its elasticity is read from its own days
label_zh: 读取弹性前至少要几天有花费的数据
explain: fewer days and the pooled value stands
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_evidence_z
label_en: how far a campaign's marginal return must be from the common level for a move: the base value, replaced by a calibrated bar when the pack calibrates one
label_zh: 边际回报离共同水位多远才调整
explain: the one-sided 95% bar; a pack that replays its own moves may set another
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_elasticity_min
label_en: the lowest elasticity of revenue to spend the rule will believe
explain: day-to-day estimates below it are noise
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_elasticity_max
label_en: the highest elasticity the rule will believe: 1 is a proportional response, no saturation
explain: the allocation assumes a concave response
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_prior_sd
label_en: how far a campaign's elasticity may sit from the pooled value before its own days outweigh it
label_zh: 弹性向合并值收缩的先验标准差
explain: a shrinkage: the smaller, the more the pooled value rules
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_flip_target
label_en: the most moves undone within a week that the calibrated evidence bar may allow
label_zh: 校准证据门槛时允许的最大来回翻比例
explain: a move that is reversed within a week was noise; the bar is the lowest one under this share
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_calibration_min_moves
label_en: the fewest moves a replay must make for its bar to be believed
label_zh: 校准至少要有几次调整
explain: a bar that moves nothing proves nothing
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: allocation_follow_days
label_en: days after a recorded proposal before it is counted as taken or not taken
label_zh: 建议记录后多少天才算有没有被采用
explain: a budget change takes a day or two to be made and seen
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client
